author: Cleo Abram
description:
Most people don’t understand how far away the Sun really is…

If you lined up all the planets in the solar system side by side, you’d make it…only from the Earth to the moon??

So how many times do you think it would take to get to the Sun? GUESS!!

But to see how far it is to the edge of our solar system, subscribe!

#planet #sun #earth #science #space
title: Guess How Far The Sun Is
